entry.open: Report a bug or send feedback
entry.openWithVersion: Report a bug or send feedback · v{{version}}

dialog.title: Tell us what happened
dialog.subtitle: Bugs, feedback and ideas, a person reads every one.
dialog.crashSubtitle: The error details are already attached. Anything you remember helps.

types.groupLabel: What kind of report is this

fields.title: Summary

titlePlaceholder.bug: What went wrong, in a few words
titlePlaceholder.crash: What were you doing when it crashed?
titlePlaceholder.idea: Your idea, in a few words

descriptionPlaceholder.bug: What were you doing, what did you expect, and what happened instead?
descriptionPlaceholder.crash: Which screen were you on? Did it happen before?
descriptionPlaceholder.feedback: What works for you, and what gets in your way?
descriptionPlaceholder.idea: What would you like LastSave to do, and when would you use it?

fields.contactPlaceholder: Discord username or email, if you want a reply
fields.contactHint: Used to answer you. Ideas may be posted in #ideas on Discord so others can vote.

images.label: Screenshots
images.hint: Paste, drop or pick up to {{max}} images.

errors.unreadable: That image could not be read.
errors.tooLarge: That image is too large even after compressing it.
errors.clipboardEmpty: There is no image on the clipboard.

diagnostics.includeDescription: The recent app log, so the problem can be traced.

items.log: The most recent lines of LastSave's own log file (up to about 1.5 MB).
items.crash: For a crash: the error and where in LastSave's code it happened, and how LastSave's last run ended if it closed unexpectedly.
items.system: App version, Windows version, language and the screen you were on.
items.install: A random ID for this installation, so several reports from one PC can be told apart. It is not tied to your name, account or hardware.
items.scrubbed: Your Windows user name and PC name are replaced before anything is sent, and tokens or passwords are never written to the log.
items.never: Never included: your library, your saves, your screenshots or anything you did not attach yourself.

sent.title: Report sent. Thank you!
sent.followUp: Reports are read privately. If you want to follow up, join our Discord and mention this ID.
sent.noReply: You did not leave a contact, so we cannot reply directly.

errors.unconfigured: This build cannot send reports. You can still reach us on Discord.
errors.offline: LastSave could not reach the report service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: That is a lot of reports in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.tooLarge: The report is too large. Remove a screenshot and try again.
errors.rejected: The report was not accepted. Updating LastSave may fix this.
errors.unavailable: The report service is having trouble right now. Try again in a moment.

crash.title: Whoops. Something happened.
crash.description: We ran into an error. Your library and your saves are safe.
crash.keepsHappening: If this keeps happening, try resetting the interface or contact us on Discord.
crash.resetTooltip: Clears saved interface state (sidebar, filters, cached images) and restarts. Your library, logs and media are not touched.

backgroundError.title: Something went wrong in the background
backgroundError.description: LastSave kept running. A report helps us fix it.

uncleanShutdown.title: LastSave closed unexpectedly last time
uncleanShutdown.description: If it crashed, a report with the log helps us find out why.

windowReloaded.title: LastSave's window crashed and was reloaded
windowReloaded.description: Nothing was lost. A report with the log helps us find out why it happened.
